tasks.label: Setup build environment
tasks.detail: Create .fontbuilder.venv, install requirements.txt into it, and compile the web console SPA when it has not been built yet. Idempotent, so it runs automatically every time the folder opens.

tasks.label: Compile web console SPA
tasks.detail: npm install + npm run build of src/composer-web into font_composer/composer/web/static/. Run this after editing the web console source.
